scope: Independent substitution-control source/replay audit and pending-PATH correction review; real tiny host recorder and synthetic native context tests

findings.summary: The actual recorder retains an empty payloads/.retention.lock, but the control reader omitted it from its semantic cache and the synthetic complete fixture omitted it entirely. A producer-correct packet was rejected at the frozen-product inventory comparison.
findings.repair: Require and consume exactly empty payloads/.retention.lock, and include it in the complete fixture before freezing. Preserve complete inventory equality.

substitution_contract.base_path: Executing Python parent, /usr/bin, /bin, deduplicated in that order; no native host-bin prefix
substitution_contract.native_loader_paths: Control work directory followed by admitted model sw/runtime directory
substitution_contract.numerical_and_provenance_checks: The same complete favorable transcript must pass against the alternate extension and reject the original extension with the exact designated library-provenance reason
